newsitem.title: INDIA: Tribal rebels kill 8 Indian soldiers, injure 13.
newsitem.headline: Tribal rebels kill 8 Indian soldiers, injure 13.

text.p: Separatist tribal guerrillas killed at least eight Indian soldiers and injured 13 in an ambush in the northeastern state of Nagaland near the Burmese border on Tuesday, police said.
They said armed guerrillas of the Maoist National Socialist Council of Nagaland attacked the convoy of soldiers, some 10 km (6 miles) from state capital Kohima.
The rebels have been fighting for an independent homeland in Nagaland state for the last five decades. More than one thousand tribesmen and Indian security personnel have died in the violence.
